verdicts.reason: Taint computation confirms Rs 333,977.15 of victim funds in this account (tainted share 63.5%). Strong mule indicators—pass-through ratio 1.58, single payer, phone shared with 29 accounts—support the mule label and justify the lien.

The lien of Rs 767,746.76 equals the traced victim funds still in the account; tainted share is only 0.4% of a large balance (Rs 18.2 crore), so the customer's own money is untouched. The account holds ~68% of the disputed amount, well above the 25% threshold, warranting the lien regardless of the genuine label.

Taint calculation confirms Rs 24,354.67 of traced victim funds sitting in this account; with a tainted share of only 0.02%, the lien affects none of the business's own funds. Despite genuine indicators, the lien correctly targets only the victim's money that flowed into the account.
